page_title: BOU 0-4 ARS | Bournemouth v Arsenal 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Arsenal.

90+6' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Neto, who tips the ball around the post. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
90+6' Michael Salisbury sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+5' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

90+3' 0 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Martin Odegaard flights the free kick into the box, where Ben White (Arsenal) peels off his marker and heads straight into the top right corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 0:4.
90+3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
90+2' Arsenal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+1' A sweet pass inside the box gives Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
87' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:12.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Smith (Bournemouth) will replace Ryan Christie.
83' That will be all from Milos Kerkez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
82' Neto (Bournemouth) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
81' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Jorginho (Arsenal) replaces Declan Rice.
81' Here's the change. Kai Havertz leaves the pitch and Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
79' Neto (Bournemouth) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
79' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Gabriel Jesus, but Neto displays great awareness to stop him.
78' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
76' Problems for Mikel Arteta as Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Fabio Vieira replaces him.
76' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Philip Billing comes off the pitch to be replaced by Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth).
75' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

73' Ambitious effort from Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
72' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
69' A substitution has been made. Oleksandr Zinchenko is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
69' Mikel Arteta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) replacing Eddie Nketiah.
68' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
68' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:5.
62' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
61' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.
61' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
60' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a foul and Michael Salisbury immediately signals a free kick.
59' Here is a change. Justin Kluivert is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
59' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier makes his way off the pitch and Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) comes on as his replacement.
58' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared by the defence.
55' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' 0 - 3 Goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Neto to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
53' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. PENALTY! One of the players from Arsenal is about to take a penalty kick.
48' Arsenal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' 4:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Neto no chance!
44' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle after Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY to Arsenal! Let's see who will take responsibility.
41' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
38' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
36' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

35' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Salisbury blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
33' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Kai Havertz (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.

30' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Salisbury with no other option than to blow for a foul.
28' Neto (Bournemouth) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Neto (Bournemouth) picks up an injury.
25' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Neto makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
25' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Declan Rice (Arsenal).

25' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
24' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
23' The free kick is delivered by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
21' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
17' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header inside the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
16' A pass by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

11' What a great touch by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.

7' Ben White (Arsenal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
6' Arsenal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bournemouth will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury is introduced as the referee for today's match.
